id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying when every sending domain rejects a table

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a specific error classification for Mailgun account/domain rejection, potentially distinguishing credential/access failures from transient network errors.
review.reason: Adds a non-retryable error entry and corresponding test assertion for the Mailgun case where every sending domain is rejected. This could help PostHog distinguish between a transient failure and a permanent account/domain access issue, potentially preventing unnecessary retries. No broader implementation or systemic change is visible.
review.uncertainty: Only supplied hunk P1.F1.H1 is available; no surrounding implementation or broader change assessment is possible. The tier is assigned based solely on the observed addition of an error entry and test, not on demonstrated systemic benefit or broader architectural changes.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are available; no other hunks, file context, or surrounding implementation are provided, so broader change assessment and tier assignment are not possible.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error entry for the case where Mailgun rejects every sending domain, and adds a test assertion checking that this error message is present and unique in the non-retryable errors set.
observations.code_quote: "request for every sending domain": "Mailgun rejected every sending domain on this account for this table. Check that your sending domains are active in Mailgun and that your API key can read them.",
observations.posthog_connection: This could help PostHog users distinguish between a credential/domain-access issue and a transient failure, potentially preventing unnecessary retries when all domains are rejected.
